cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, regulation, policy or standard in force requires public information, websites or digital services to be accessible to persons with disabilities.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13: the Blind Assistant app, backed by the government's e-Booster Programme (UGA-007), adds to delivery already held, but no source says a rule in force requires accessible public information or services, so the UCUSAF ICT4PWD programme (UGA-004) holds the cell at 2 and delivery cannot lift it.
